# Returns process

Returned pallets are received at door 7.

## Steps

- Inspect the pallet.
- Record the reason code.
- Move stock to the returns cage.

## Reason codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| R1 | Damaged in transit |
| R2 | Wrong item |

Escalate anything without a code to the shift lead.
